summary:
Fixed the auth bypass.

The needle was the mismatch between raw path checks in auth and cleaned path matching in the router. I added shared route normalization in [app/main.go](/app/app/main.go:73) and made auth use it in [app/middleware.go](/app/app/middleware.go:12), so `//api/admin` and `/health/../api/data` are treated as protected API routes before dispatch.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes, including both bypass cases returning `401`.

Note: `test.sh` rebuilds `/app/server`, so the generated `server` binary is currently modified along with the two source files.
